checks.detail: stale map claimed 12345 drift; the battery reported 0 (truth 0)

decisions.A1: the integrity one-liner names the non-ok checks and carries each check's own first sentence of remediation
decisions.A1_bound: healthy adds nothing; a pathological project names 3 and counts the rest
decisions.A2: per-language searchability is the join of the language census and the embedding census, over the same rows a semantic reader searches
decisions.A3: this call's cost is measured per phase and labelled as distinct from the last index run's
decisions.A3_bound: zero-valued phases are omitted so a warm call stays one short line

limitations: Phase timings are wall-clock on a shared machine and are asserted for STRUCTURE (present, non-negative, ordered, non-zero only when the phase ran) rather than for a duration, which no gate can pin.
